Title: Governance/staking mutates consensus state outside a block
Summary: RPC governance writes change the committed state root locally without a block; peers reject the block (desync/halt).
Recommendation: Move governance into a block-carried operation or forbid governance writes on validators/multi-node.

Title: Unauthenticated governance identity + permanent stake lock
Summary: proposer/voter from RPC params unsigned; anyone votes with чужой weight and locks victim stake; finalize never called live so lock is permanent.
Recommendation: Require signatures; cap the lock; wire finalize live; fail closed without token.

Title: Write methods fail open when STELL_RPC_AUTH_TOKEN is unset
Summary: Governance/deploy/call/sign execute without token; KI-19 claim is wrong except mempoolDump.
Recommendation: Fail closed on None or require explicit dev flag; fix docs + startup warning.

Title: stell_signMessage signs with the validator key
Summary: Node signs arbitrary messages with the vote/block Ed25519 key; unauthenticated when no token.
Recommendation: Never use the validator key; dev-only separate key behind token on loopback.

Title: stell_callContract double-executes and double-charges
Summary: Direct path moves value + runs contract immediately then submits equivalent tx applied again on inclusion.
Recommendation: Remove direct mutation; execute on clone for results only.

Title: stell_deployContract accepts plaintext private_key and mutates state outside a block
Summary: Private key over RPC (leak risk) + immediate deploy outside block (C-01).
Recommendation: Remove private_key; signed raw-tx only; no out-of-block mutation.

Title: STELL_PURE_PQ is opt-in and off by default
Summary: Node accepts classical Ed25519 without the flag; README/perf claims assume PQ.
Recommendation: Enable PQ in default profiles or document opt-in; separate PQ perf.

Title: EVM chain id hardcoded to 5757 while eth_chainId serves STELL_CHAIN_ID
Summary: Custom chain id breaks all EVM txs (signed one id
column9: Single chain-id source or document 5757-only EVM.

Title: pq_keys restore unvalidated; non-default salt breaks healing
Summary: Snapshot pairs installed verbatim; healing with DEFAULT_SALT cannot restore other-salt accounts.
Recommendation: Validate blake3(pk) + derive() vs address; persist salt; restart test.

Title: BoC with_capacity before length validation (KI-35)
Recommendation: Check len vs remaining bytes or try_reserve.

Title: No root Cargo.lock; infnode from git branch main
Recommendation: Commit Cargo.lock; pin infnode rev; cargo audit/dependabot.

Title: Compact propagation and PQ transport design-only; PQ cert size ~42.6KB
Summary: Lightweight mechanisms unwired; 1k-TPS recipe is Ed25519-only.
Recommendation: Ship compact + PQ transport; measure PQ end-to-end; label measured vs projected.

Title: Bincode length-prefix amplification on untrusted bytes
Summary: Input caps exist but length prefixes may drive allocation; consensus_net has with_limit.
Recommendation: Central helper with_limit + reject_trailing_bytes; fuzz pathological prefixes.

Title: Ignored Falcon FFI return codes
Summary: C keygen/sign return int declared as (); failures ignored.
Recommendation: Return i32; fail closed on non-zero.

Title: Cell::new uses assert! on limits
Summary: Public constructor aborts instead of error.
